datasets.title: Preliminary Satellite Flood Assessment Report, Dadaab Refugee Camp, Kenya
datasets.description: UNOSAT code FL20230321KEN Status: Increased water extent observed Further action(s): continue monitoring Summary of findings: Increased water observed along Lagh Dera River in the vicinity of Dagahaley Refugee Camp as of 21 March 2023; Cloud cover over Dagahaley and Ifo Refugee Camp as of 21 March 2023; Potentially flooded areas observed in Dadaab town as of 21 March 2023; Increased water in the whole river basin observed around the Dadaab Refugee Complex as of 21 March 2023.. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/preliminary-satellite-flood-assessment-report-dadaab-refugee-camp-kenya]
datasets.details: This is a preliminary assessment and has not yet been validated in the field. It is important to consider the characteristics of the source imagery used in the analyses when interpreting results. For damage assessments it should be noted that only significant damage to the structural integrity of the buildings analyzed can be seen in imagery, while minor damage such as cracks or holes may not be visible at all. For flood extractions using radar data it is important to note that urban areas and highly vegetated areas may mask the flood signature and result in underestimation of flood waters. Users with specific questions or concerns should contact unosat@unitar.org to seek clarification.

lineage.description: UNOSAT analysts reviewed and compared satellite imagery acquired on 21 March 2023 to detect changes in water extent and identify flooded areas along the Lagh Dera River and in Dadaab town. The assessment identified increased water in the river basin and potentially flooded areas through visual interpretation of satellite imagery, producing a preliminary post-event flood assessment report.

sources.name: United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT)
sources.description: Satellite imagery analysis and change detection comparing pre- and post-event images to identify increased water extent and flooded areas in the Dadaab Refugee Complex region
